第一卷 第52章 断风大阵开（第1页）

断风大阵，开！（断风大阵，开！（第22页）每一头血尸妖傀在走动的时候，地面都在震颤。断风营的士卒哪能眼睁睁地看着这些血尸妖傀靠近自家将军！虽然一对一，他们都不是血尸妖傀的对手，但是他们并没有后退。几个士卒结成一个小阵，杀不了血尸妖傀，但是能给他造成不小的麻烦，迟滞它到达城楼的时间。哪怕只有一瞬间，那也够了。之前秦烈觉得血尸妖傀很强，但现在看来的话，也就大概二品上下的实力。对于普通士卒来说，确实强得离谱，但在阵法的加持下，拿命挡住他们的脚步还是没问题的。沈书彦没有往那边看，并不是他冷血，而是这个时候往那边看已经没有用了，不能让这些人的牺牲变得毫无意义。半空中，镇关印下方的血肉残甲断刀已经彻底融合到了一起。在镇关印下不断压缩，慢慢的变成了钉子的模样。秦烈抬头数了一下，一共八枚。每一枚钉子都有手臂长短，全身漆黑，上面缠绕着暗红色的血纹。沈书彦抬起手，八枚钉子缓缓落下，悬在他身前。此时此刻，他的脸白得吓人，但是手上的动作却很稳。裴惊寒看着那八枚黑钉，低声说道：“开始吧。”“钉子钉进你的身体里会很疼！”“少废话！”“你……疼死你活该！”虽然沈书彦嘴上这么说，但秦烈还是能看得出来，他的眼眶已经红了。他和裴惊寒是这么多年的好友，现在让他亲手把这些钉子全都打进裴惊寒的身体里面，这恐怕比他自己挨了这八钉还要难受。但是沈书彦没有选择，裴惊寒也没有选择，只能如此放手一搏。沈书彦抬手一指，第一枚黑钉飞了一出去。钉子直接钉入了裴惊寒的左肩，裴惊寒身体猛然一震。左臂上原本还在翻涌的妖气像是被一只大手按住了一样，瞬间往回缩。但是代价也很明显，裴惊寒的整条左臂都垂下去了，看着像是一点力气也使不出来。沈书彦的动作并没有停，第二根黑钉直接飞入裴惊寒的右肩。现在他两条手臂都动不了了。裴惊寒低头看了一眼自己的手，扯了扯嘴角。“好了，现在真的成废人了！”沈书彦冷着脸。“闭嘴，现在还有心情说笑，看来是我钉子下的太轻了。”“你倒是想钉得重一点，你有那实力吗？”秦烈听着他们两个说话，心里就更堵了。明明是很痛苦的事情，为什么偏偏要装作轻松的样子？沈书彦接着抬手，第三枚、第四枚黑钉同时飞起。噗！噗！两枚黑钉分别钉入了裴惊寒的双腿。裴惊寒这一次没忍住，身体直接往前一跪，膝盖重重砸在地板上。和膝盖接触的地板直接裂开。沈书彦的声音继续响起。“第五钉，锁气海。”第五枚黑钉飞起，直接刺进裴惊寒的腹部。裴惊寒猛然仰头，一股黑红色的妖气从他口鼻中喷了出来，紧接着又被那枚黑钉硬生生地压了回去。秦烈用望气术看得最清楚，裴惊寒体内最混乱的地方就是气海。气海被封锁了，等于武夫最重要的力量源头被废了。裴惊寒咬着牙，声音从牙缝里挤出来。“继续。”沈书彦眼神一沉。“第六钉，锁心口。”第六枚黑钉悬在半空，没有立刻落下。

Volume 1 Chapter 52 The Wind-breaking Formation Opens (Page 1)
Breaking Wind Formation, start! (Duefeng Formation, open! (Page 22) The ground is shaking when every Blood Corpse Demon Puppet moves around. How can the soldiers of Duan Feng camp watch these Blood Corpse Demon Puppet approach their general! Although one on one, they are no match for the Blood Corpse Demon Puppet, but they do not retreat. A few soldiers form a small formation and cannot kill the Blood Corpse Demon Puppet, but they can cause him a lot of trouble and delay its arrival at the tower. Even if it is only for a moment. , That's enough. Qin Lie thought that the Blood Corpse Demon Puppet was very strong before, but now it seems that it is only about the second level. For ordinary soldiers, it is indeed ridiculously strong, but with the blessing of the formation, it is still no problem to block their footsteps. Shen Shuyan did not look over there, but it was useless to look over there at this time, and the sacrifices of these people under the seal were not made meaningless. The Broken Armor and Broken Knives were completely fused together, and gradually turned into nails under the Zhenguan Seal. Qin Lie looked up and counted eight nails in total, and the whole body was dark. Wrapped with dark red blood lines, Shen Shuyan raised his hand, and the eight nails slowly fell down in front of him. At this moment, his face was frighteningly white, but his movements were very steady. Pei Jinghan looked at the eight black nails and whispered. : "Let's start." "It will hurt when nails are driven into your body!" "Stop talking nonsense!" "You... deserve to be hurt to death!" Although Shen Shuyan said this, Qin Lie could still see that his eyes were red. Having been friends with Pei Jinghan for so many years, it would be more uncomfortable for him to drive all these nails into Pei Jinghan's body with his own hands. But Shen Shuyan had no choice, and neither did Pei Jinghan. He had no choice but to give it a try. Shen Shuyan raised his hand and the first black nail flew out. The nail was driven directly into Pei Jinghan's left shoulder, and the evil energy that was still surging on his left arm suddenly shook. He held it down with his big hand and immediately retracted it, but the cost was obvious. Pei Jinghan's entire left arm dropped, and it looked like he couldn't use any strength. The second black nail flew straight away without stopping. Pei Jinghan's right shoulder. Now he couldn't move either of his arms. Pei Jinghan looked down at his hands and twitched his lips. "Okay, I'm really useless now!" Shen Shuyan said with a cold face. Qing was joking, it seems that I nailed it too lightly. "You want to nail it harder, do you have the strength?" Qin Lie felt even more blocked when he heard the two of them talking. It is obviously a very painful thing, why do you have to pretend? Looking relaxed? Shen Shuyan then raised his hand, and the third and fourth black nails flew up at the same time. Puff! Two black nails were driven into Pei Jinghan's legs. This time, Pei Jinghan didn't hold back and knelt forward. It hit the floor hard. The floor in contact with his knees cracked. "The fifth nail, Qi Sea." The fifth black nail flew up and stabbed directly into Pei Jinghan's abdomen. Pei Jinghan suddenly raised his head. Black-red demonic energy spurted out from his mouth and nose, and was then forced back by the black nail. Qin Lie used his Qi-gazing technique to see clearly that the most chaotic part of Pei Jinghan's body was the sea of Qi, which was equivalent to being blocked. Wu Fu's most important source of strength was destroyed. Pei Jinghan gritted his teeth and said through his teeth, "Continue." Shen Shuyan's eyes darkened. "The sixth nail, lock the heart." The sixth black nail hung in the air and did not fall immediately.
